home_offline: Works offline · Internet only for search and download
home_no_runs: No runs yet. Open a project and press Run.
home_import_sub: Download a public repository's text files to read and edit.
resume_text: The last training did not finish. It can continue from its saved checkpoint.
set_training_note: Checkpoints let training continue after a crash. Verifying re-computes every step on the CPU and fixes wrong results.
set_assistant_note: Ask ChatGPT opens ChatGPT with text you review; PocketTrainer never sends it by itself. The page goes online only when you search, import or download. The Assistant tab stays an offline, rule-based coach.
about_text: PocketTrainer trains a small AI right in your browser. It double-checks every training step with a second, independent calculation, so a silent error cannot ruin the result.
about_data:
CIFAR-10 photos (Krizhevsky, 2009)
ResNet50 features: torchvision ImageNet weights (BSD-3-Clause)
Training and editing work offline. The internet permission is used only when you import from GitHub.
about_translations: Translations are machine-assisted and may contain mistakes.
ed_note: PocketTrainer runs your settings with its built-in trainer (not full Python).
ed_hist_none: No older versions yet. A copy is kept each time you save a change.
ed_err_lr: learning_rate must be a number from 0.001 to 1.
ed_err_hidden: hidden_units must be a whole number from 8 to 512.
ed_err_epochs: epochs must be a whole number from 1 to 30.
ed_not_runnable: This project can be read and edited. PocketTrainer can only run recipes with its built-in trainer (not full Python).
ed_map_after: The four recipe lines were added at the top of code/model.py. Your original code was not changed or run.
lab_intro: These buttons break training on purpose, to show what the protection does. Then run it here, or go to Editor and press Run.
lab_verify_sub: Double-check every step on the CPU
lab_crash_note: The training worker is killed in the middle of training (everything in memory is lost); reopen or press Resume and it continues from the last checkpoint stored in your browser.
lab_crash_note_off: Turn on "Save checkpoints" first, then the training worker can be killed mid-training and continue from the checkpoint.
lab_android_note: Android note: the system interruption here is a software simulation — we inject one invalid (NaN) value into a weight update. The iOS version uses a real GPU recovery event.
lab_compare_note: Runs None / Checkpoint-only / Our method side by side with the same interruption (3 epochs, 64 hidden units).
cmp_explain: Checkpoint-only can restart after a crash, but it cannot see a wrong update, so it saves the ruined weights. Our method catches the wrong update before it is written.
banner_failed: ✗ Training silently failed — accuracy %1$d%% (no error was shown)
banner_fixed_one: ⚠ Error detected and fixed automatically (%1$d time)
banner_fixed_many: ⚠ Error detected and fixed automatically (%1$d times)
env_no_conflict: ✓ No conflicts: nothing the project needs clashes with the built-in components.
notes_made: Made from your last runs by simple rules, on this phone.
plan_compare: Compare results and write a note
notes_empty: No notes yet. Press + Add note.
note_hint: # Try a smaller learning rate next time.
asst_line: Accuracy %1$.1f%% · learning rate %2$s · %3$d hidden units · %4$d epochs
asst_note: This coach only looks at the numbers of your recent runs. It does not use the internet or a large AI model.
adv_lr_gave: Learning rate %1$s gave %2$.1f%%, %3$s gave %4$.1f%% — it controls update size
adv_compare: Compare train loss (%1$.2f) and validation loss (%2$.2f)
adv_compare_plain: Compare train loss and validation loss
adv_ckpt: Checkpoint saved at step %1$d: checkpoints let you resume later
coach_none: Run a project first. Then I can look at your numbers and suggest what to try next.
coach_wrong: Your accuracy is %1$d%%, far below a normal run. Verification was off, so a silent error may have ruined training. Turn on "Verify training results" in Settings.
coach_fixed_one: Verification found and fixed %1$d wrong step. Without it this run could have been silently wrong.
coach_fixed_many: Verification found and fixed %1$d wrong steps. Without it this run could have been silently wrong.
coach_flat: The loss barely went down. Try a bigger learning rate, for example %1$s.
coach_gap: Validation loss is higher than training loss by %1$.2f. The model may be memorising the photos: try fewer epochs or fewer hidden units.
coach_epochs_one: Only %1$d epoch — try more epochs so the model sees the photos more times.
coach_epochs_many: Only %1$d epochs — try more epochs so the model sees the photos more times.
coach_lr_large: A learning rate of %1$s is large. If the loss bounces up and down, try 0.05.
coach_compare: Compared with your previous run: learning rate %1$s → %2$s changed accuracy from %3$.1f%% to %4$.1f%%.
coach_ok: This run looks healthy. Change one number at a time (for example the learning rate) and compare the curves.
imp_help: Paste a public address like https://github.com/owner/repo (a /tree/branch/folder or /blob/branch/file link also works).
imp_rules: Only text files are downloaded (up to 200 files, 5 MB). They are shown and edited, never executed. The internet is used only while importing. Check the project's license before using or sharing it.
imp_license_warn: Files are shown and edited only; nothing is run. Check the project's license before using or sharing it.
imp_license_no: No LICENSE file was found in this repository.
imp_err_blocked: Blocked address: only https links to GitHub are allowed.
imp_err_offline: Could not reach GitHub. PocketTrainer works offline — try again when you are online.
imp_err_limit: GitHub is limiting requests right now. Please try again in a few minutes.
imp_err_404: Not found. Check the address (the repository must be public).
imp_err_notext: That file type is not text, so it is not downloaded.
imp_err_empty: No text files were found at that address.
ask_explain: This is the exact text that will be sent. Read it, edit it, and add your own question. Nothing is sent by PocketTrainer: the text is copied and ChatGPT opens in a new tab, where you press send yourself.
ask_text_label: Text to send (you can edit it)
ask_mic_unavailable: Speech recognition is not available on this device.
ask_mic_note: The browser's speech recognition turns your voice into text. In Chrome this may go through Google's cloud, so it is not offline. PocketTrainer itself does not record sound.
ask_copied: Full text copied. If ChatGPT shows only part of it, paste it.
ask_copied_cut: Text is long: only the first 1500 characters go in the link. Full text copied — paste it in ChatGPT.
ask_no_browser: No app can open the link on this device. The text was copied.
find_sub: Search GitHub and Hugging Face, then download and set up.
search_cached: Showing saved results (you are offline or limited).
search_lic_warn: Check the license before using or sharing it.
detail_confirm_text: %1$s. Check the license before using or sharing it. Download the text files of this project?
setup_st_analyze: Reading the file list and requirements
setup_st_resolve: Checking requirements against the built-in components
pkg_reason_python: PocketTrainer doesn't run Python packages; only its built-in trainer runs recipes.
pkg_reason_heavy: PocketTrainer doesn't run Python packages (this one is also very large).
weights_note: Large files are only listed. You can download one (up to 50 MB). It is stored and shown, never executed.
web_tables_sub: Train on a CSV / JSONL table in your browser.
web_crashed: Simulated crash at step %1$d: the training worker was killed. Press Resume to continue from the checkpoint.
web_chart_note: Loss: smaller is better. Accuracy: higher is better, measured on test examples the model has never seen.
web_sim_note: Browsers don't expose real GPU interruptions; this is a software simulation (one invalid value is injected into the first calculation).
web_measure_note: Times five real training steps in this browser (no fake watchdog).
web_measure_est: about %1$d s for the default run
web_mic_note: Speech input uses the browser's speech recognition. In Chrome it may go through Google's cloud (not offline).
web_no_pkgs: No packages found in this project.
web_notes_made: Made from your last runs by simple rules, in your browser.
web_about_text: PocketTrainer trains a small AI right in your browser. It double-checks every training step with a second, independent calculation, so a silent error cannot ruin the result. Everything runs on your computer; the page goes online only to search, import or download.
web_about_data:
CIFAR-10 photos (Krizhevsky, 2009)
ResNet50 features: torchvision ImageNet weights (BSD-3-Clause)
Iris, Wine: UCI Machine Learning Repository (CC BY 4.0)
ONNX Runtime Web (MIT)
web_about_version: Version 2 · Web (CPU, runs in your browser)
web_tables_intro: Pick a table (CSV or JSONL), choose the label column and the feature columns, and train the same two-layer network on it, with the same protection.
web_tab_note: Features are standardised (mean 0, spread 1, using the training part only). 80% of rows train, 20% test.
web_tab_nofeat: Choose at least one numeric feature column.
web_tab_split: %1$d training rows · %2$d test rows · %3$d features · %4$d classes
web_image_intro: Download a small image-classification model (ONNX) from Hugging Face, run it in your browser on one of your pictures, and check that two different back-ends (CPU/WASM and WebGPU) agree.
web_onnx_gpu_yes: WebGPU is available in this browser: the picture will run on CPU (WASM) and on the GPU.
web_onnx_gpu_no: WebGPU is not available in this browser, so only the CPU (WASM) run is done. WebGPU also needs https or localhost and a recent desktop Chrome or Edge.
web_onnx_diff: ⚠ GPU result differs from CPU — possible silent error
web_onnx_cpu_only: CPU (WASM) result only: no WebGPU to compare with.
web_onnx_cmp: Cosine similarity %1$s · largest difference %2$s · same top-1: %3$s
demo_sub: One tap runs the same training twice with the same interruption: once with no protection, once with protection.
